#define _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int main() {
#ifdef _DEBUG
	freopen("in.txt", "r", stdin);
	freopen("out.txt", "w", stdout);
#endif
	int n;
	cin >> n;
	vector<int> a(n);
	for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
		cin >> a[i];
	}
	sort(begin(a), end(a));
	cout << a.at(n / 2) << endl;
	return 0;
}
